subject: proj-dy
title: (R)PROJ.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in CMBA-29, the second on book p273, closing the section. (R)PROJ-DY — the reality of projectional dynamics — is crossed with MT-INFO (music information). The diagram uses three prefixed nodes — (R)INFO-INTR (the reality of information interpretation), (C)POST (the concept of postulation), (R)PART (the reality of participation) — staging the structural question of whether real projectional dynamics actually delivers transformation when music information is its crossing partner. MT-INFO → PROJ-DY (the subject). (C)POST is fed by SOC-RT (social reality), and POST outputs to PROJ-DY, T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). T-C-IMP → MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). (R)INFO-INTR → (R)PART, and (R)PART → MTA-RT-SIGN. Structural argument: real projectional dynamics is fed by both music information *and* the concept of postulation, with postulation itself fed by social reality and reaching dynamic functionalism, time-continuum implications, and projectional dynamics in parallel. The reality of information interpretation produces the reality of participation, which converges with time-continuum implications at meta-reality significance — the only convergence point in the diagram. The diagram thus closes the section by diagramming how meta-reality significance — the cosmic-scale meaning Braxton has been arguing for throughout — is achieved structurally: through the parallel routes of postulation→time-continuum and information-interpretation→participation, meeting only at meta-reality significance and nowhere else.
